summary: Vitalik 把 2023 年路线图叠加到当前 Strawmap 上，总体重合度高，但量子安全被提前，部分事项降级。Base 的 chunter-cb 提交 EIP-8130 大改：账户配置合约更名为 Keystore 合约，与 base/eip-8130 规范实现对齐，规范只保留共识层面。Marchhill 为 EIP-7906 补三处会导致客户端分歧的定义并当天合并。kassandra 展示 kohaku-cli 用一个 4337 UserOp 完成隐身地址转账和公告。

items.topic: 原生 AA 的两条路线都在推进
items.title: EIP-8130：与 Keystore 合约对齐、交易有效期窗口、精简规范
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。账户配置合约更名为 Keystore 合约（`KEYSTORE_ADDRESS`、`IKeystore`），与规范实现 `base/eip-8130` 对齐，存储布局、typehash、事件 ABI、函数体等合约内部细节交给该仓库，EIP 只保留协议共识层面。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: align with Keystore contract, transaction validity window, slim spec
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. The Account Configuration contract is renamed the Keystore contract (`KEYSTORE_ADDRESS`, `IKeystore`) and aligned with the canonical `base/eip-8130` implementation; contract internals such as storage layout, typehashes, event ABIs and function bodies are deferred to that repository, and the EIP keeps only the protocol consensus surface.
items.topic_en: Both native AA tracks move forward

items.topic: 原生 AA 的两条路线都在推进
items.title: EIP-7906：规定保留的“必须为 0”输入的处理
items.note: （Marchhill）合并。`TXTRACE`/`TXDIFF` 有若干操作数标为必须为 0，但没规定非零时怎么办；它们运行在 `POST_TX` frame，分歧会改变交易后状态进而影响区块有效性，PR 规定非零即异常终止。同日合并的还有 按 EIP-7928 记录 TXDIFF 状态读取 和 精确定义 contracts_deployed。
items.title_en: EIP-7906: specify handling of reserved "must be 0" inputs
items.note_en: (Marchhill), merged. Several `TXTRACE`/`TXDIFF` operands are marked must be 0, but the spec never said what happens on a non-zero value; since these run in a `POST_TX` frame, a divergence changes post-transaction state and so block validity, and the PR makes a non-zero value an exceptional halt. Also merged that day: record TXDIFF state reads per EIP-7928 and define contracts_deployed precisely.
items.topic_en: Both native AA tracks move forward

summary_en: Vitalik overlaid his 2023 roadmap onto the current Strawmap: overlap is high, but quantum safety moved up and some items were deprioritized. Base's chunter-cb submitted a major EIP-8130 rewrite: the account configuration contract becomes the Keystore contract, aligned with the base/eip-8130 canonical implementation, and the spec keeps only the consensus surface. Marchhill filled three gaps in EIP-7906 that would have made clients diverge, all merged the same day. kassandra showed kohaku-cli doing a stealth-address transfer and its announcement in a single 4337 UserOp.
